a:

you can do this:
public class customXXXXX
    public property XXXXXname as string
    public property icon as string
    public property text as string
    public property isenabled as boolean
    public property size as string
    public sub new()

       'make the XXXXX icon.
        dim iconstring as string = formaticon(new dimension(40, 40), "", true)

       'make the XXXXX name.
        dim XXXXXname as new cultureinfo("eng-", false)

       'make the XXXXX text.
        dim XXXXXtext as new resourcestring(
